race.comment: LUMINOUS GIRL (5) has been building nicely this prep, and she produced a strong finishing effort when third at Ipswich last start. She will need the breaks at the right time, but with even luck she looks the one to beat. MASHEAN (6) made her Queensland debut from the Adam Campton stable with a solid runner-up finish over 800m at Ipswich on a soft track. She should take improvement from that effort and she can go one better in this. IGOTMYMINDONYOU (1) has the speed to offset a wide draw and should be able to find the lead early. If left alone in front, she will take plenty of catching. STAFFO (7) resumes from a spell and she only has to run up to her early trial form to be a top 4 hope in this. Include in all combinations to be safe.
